about_the_game:
Epic Team Battles
Gods of Fire is a free-to-play, team-based 5v5 dragon battle game where strategy and skill decide victory.

Take flight across a forgotten world where civilizations have fallen, but the war never ended. Eliminate enemies and capture enemy bases to drain their tickets while defending your own. Work with your squad, unleash your dragon’s abilities, and dominate the skies in a burning war for supremacy.

Burn your enemies, protect your base, and fight alongside your team.

Dragon Combat

Control powerful dragons in competitive, high-speed 5v5 aerial battles. Master flight mechanics, unleash fireballs and devastating breath attacks, and use unique dragon perks to gain the upper hand. Command the skies with precision and use the environment to your advantage — from high-altitude ruins and open skies to narrow passages perfect for ambushing your enemies.

Ticket-Based Warfare
Each team begins with a set number of tickets — the lifeline of your team. Every elimination and captured base drains enemy tickets, while each death costs your team valuable points. Matches are fast-paced and time-limited, ending when one side runs out or the clock runs down. To win, you must strike hard, defend your territory, and coordinate with your team to claim victory.

Dragons & Customization
Choose from different dragons, each with unique abilities, strengths, and weaknesses, allowing you to master your own playstyle. Upgrade your dragon, unlock new skins, and enhance its abilities to make it even more powerful. Unlock and equip special perks — unique dragon powers that can be used during matches, from shields that protect you to toxic trails that damage enemies flying behind you. Whether you favor precision, agility, or raw power, your dragon becomes a true reflection of your strategy and identity in battle.

Key Features 

  • Epic 5v5 Dragon Battles – Compete in fast-paced, team-based aerial PvP where strategy and teamwork decide victory.

  • Ticket-Based System – Eliminate enemies and capture objectives to drain the enemy team’s tickets before they drain yours.

  • Dragon Customization – Unlock purely cosmetic skins, upgrade abilities, and equip unique dragon perks to match your playstyle.

  • Consumable Battle Cards – Equip up to two cards per match to gain tactical advantages, such as temporary boosts or extra XP.

  • Loot Chests & Rewards – Open chests with keys to discover rare skins not available in the store, powerful consumables, XP boosts, gold, and GPoints.

  • Immersive Arenas – Fight across a post-apocalyptic world of fallen civilizations, from open skies and ruins to narrow passages perfect for ambushes.

Free-to-Play – Victory comes from skill, coordination, and mastery of your dragon.
